title: koanophyllon solidaginoides
intro: Koanophyllon solidaginoides, commonly known as the "Bourbon Island Goldenseal" or "Koanophyllon", is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of the western Indian Ocean, particularly on the island of Réunion. The health benefits of Koanophyllon solidaginoides include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
